name: Soyuz TMA-04M
about: Soyuz TMA-04M (2012-022A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMM), launched 2012 May 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2012 May 15), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
